function.name: read_preview_element_context
function.description:
Resolve a site-preview selected element to its current Page, View, or Layout source HTML.
Use this for server-rendered Page/View/Layout sources in a preview-element selection.
For Vue runtime moduleUrl sources, resolve the Script resource with list_site_object and read it with read_object_text instead.
Pass flat arguments only — never wrap the whole preview-element object:
- nameOrId: preview-element.source.nameOrId (Page/View/Layout name or id)
- objectType: preview-element.source.type when it is Page, View, or Layout
- cssSelector: preview-element.locator.cssSelector
- tagName: preview-element.snapshot.tagName
- text: preview-element.snapshot.text
- outerHtml: preview-element.snapshot.outerHTML
If source.type is Unknown or nameOrId is missing, first identify the owner with list_site_object/read_object_text, then call this function.
The selector is source-relative when possible. Snapshot fields disambiguate selectors or rendered markup that do not match source exactly.
The result is read-only and contains the matched source element, parent HTML, line, match strategy, and body hash. Use it before update_text_object for edits.

nameOrId.description: Page/View/Layout name or id. Map from preview-element.source.nameOrId.

objectType.description: Must be Page, View, or Layout. Map from preview-element.source.type when known.

cssSelector.description: Source-relative CSS selector. Map from preview-element.locator.cssSelector.

tagName.description: Selected rendered element tag. Map from preview-element.snapshot.tagName.

text.description: Selected rendered element text. Map from preview-element.snapshot.text.

outerHtml.description: Selected rendered element outer HTML. Map from preview-element.snapshot.outerHTML.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
